description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Accuracy (%) of various methods across three different categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Mathverse", "MMLU", and "Physics", presented in that order. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 2. The chart features grouped bars for each category on the horizontal axis, with each group consisting of six bars distinguished by color and pattern as indicated in the legend. The legend maps a solid blue box to "DAPO+Self-reflection", a light blue box with diagonal hatching to "DAPO", a solid orange box to "SRPO", a solid green box to "PPO+Self-reflection", and a light green box with diagonal hatching to "PPO". Additionally, there is a light orange box with diagonal hatching in the legend that is paired with a blank grey rectangle instead of a text label. Within each category group, the bars appear from left to right in the following order: light blue hatched (DAPO), solid blue (DAPO+Self-reflection), light orange hatched (unlabeled), solid orange (SRPO), light green hatched (PPO), and solid green (PPO+Self-reflection). All bars are outlined in black. The shortest bar in the chart is the light blue hatched DAPO bar in the Mathverse category, with an approximate value of 53.1%. The tallest bar is the solid blue DAPO+Self-reflection bar in the Physics category, reaching approximately 61.0%. The bars are not sorted by height within their groups, and dashed gridlines are present in the background for both the horizontal and vertical axes.
